main_text.p: men,& parietis ftipulă: fpiritus uefter (ue-lut) ignis abfumetuos. Eruntque populi (quafi)combuftiones calcis:& quafi fpinæ eradicatæ igni exurentur. Audite qui longè abeftis quid fecerim : cognofcite & ui-cini fortitudinem meam . Pauerút in Zion peccatores : tremor apprehendit hypocri-tas : Quis ex nobis manebit iuxta ignem deuorantem?& quis ex nobis habitabit iu-xta incendia perpetua?Qui ambulat in iu-fticijs,& loquitur quæ recta funt, execra-tur lucrum ex calumnijs(proueniens,) ex-cutit manus fuas à fufceptione muneris, obturat aurem fuam ne audiat ( de inno-centi effufione)fanguinum,& cohibet ocu-los fuos ne uideat malum . Ille in excelsis habitabit, fortalicia petrarum asylum eius: panis ei datur,& aquæ eius indefinentes funt. Regem in decore fuo uidebunt oculi tui:uidebunt(regem)terræ longinquarum (regionum.) Cor tuum meditabatur ter-rorem,ubinám effet fcriba, ubi pondera-tor, ubi qui annotaret domos infigniores. Populum impudentem non uidebis : nec populum qui profundi eft labij audies,cui ftridula eft lingua abfq; intelligentia. Afpi-ce Zion ciuitatem folennitatū noftrarum:

page.notes: Printed "y 2" at foot is the gathering signature; "oculi" is the catchword. Two-column-free page; no marginal notes. Text is set in long-s-free roman type with some printed abbreviations (&, q;, ꝑ-free) kept as printed. Doubtful readings: "afylum" may be printed as "asylum"; "Pauerút" and "folennitatū" carry printed tildes as seen. Printed page number 339 at head right.
